jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.content: <p>ExampleCo is hiring a Senior Data Analyst to own forecasting and Power BI dashboards. This role is fully remote. We sponsor visas. You will use SQL and Python every day.</p>

jobs.title: Analytics Lead
jobs.content: <p>ExampleCo needs an Analytics Lead to run the reporting team. This role is fully remote. We sponsor visas. SQL required.</p>

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.content: <p>Supervise the warehouse shift. Candidates must already hold the right to work in the country; we cannot sponsor.</p>
